explanation: The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created the heavens, the earth, and all life.
The term used to describe God's act of bringing the universe and everything in it into existence.
The prophet who engages in an honest dialogue with God about injustice and violence.
Unjust actions and abuse of power that the prophet laments in his land.
The law given by God, which the prophet fears is being overshadowed by injustice.
God's response to the prophet to look at nations (the Chaldeans) whom He will use as an instrument.
A powerful and cruel nation that God promises to raise up to punish Judah.
The trust the prophet must have in God's justice even when circumstances look dark.
God's attribute of doing what is right, which the prophet asks to be demonstrated in a time of chaos.
